perItem.finding: The label is honest. RCW 13.50.260(1)-(2) relief is court-initiated: the court sets the administrative sealing hearing at disposition and enters the sealing order on its own findings, so the participant files nothing and there is no participant-facing document for this family to name. The three JU pattern forms (JU 10.0300 Motion and Declaration to Seal Records of Juvenile Offender, JU 10.0315 Notice of Respondent's Motion to Seal, JU 10.0320 Order Re: Sealing Records of Juvenile Offender) are real, are published by Washington Courts and are the MOTION path under RCW 13.50.260(3) — a different route, which the Captain has already decided is a separate family if it is wanted at all.

captainsQuestionAnswered.question: Does the FORM-1021IP instruction-packet trick — the full face of Form 281 and Form 283 printed inside the instruction packet — hold for the SBI mandatory expungement application?
captainsQuestionAnswered.answer: NO. It does not hold, and the reason is substantive rather than accidental.
captainsQuestionAnswered.howIChecked: All three held Delaware instruction PDFs were extracted in full with pdftotext -layout and read: FORM-1021IP (15 pages), CIV-EXP-06-A (12 pages), CIV-EXP-07-A (4 pages). Every occurrence of 'mandatory', 'SBI', 'application' and 'Form 28' was inspected in context.
captainsQuestionAnswered.whatFORM1021IPActuallyCarries: It does carry the face of Form 281 (its own page prints the header 'Form 281' and the body line 'any additional charges are listed on Form 281E') and it names Form 283, and its 'Required Forms for Adult Expungement' list is 'Petition for Expungement of an Adult Record (Form 281); Order Granting Expungement of an Adult Record (Form 283)'. Not one of its 15 pages carries an SBI application face or an SBI form number.
captainsQuestionAnswered.whyNot: Because the publisher does not publish one. FORM-1021IP: 'Mandatory Expungements: Unless the relevant misdemeanor conviction is listed on Exhibit A, 11 Del. C. § 4373(b) Exclusions, upon application, SBI must expunge felonies, misdemeanors or violations found in Titles 4, 7, 11, 16 or 23 of the Delaware Code in any of the three following situations...' — 'upon application' with no form named. CIV-EXP-07-A (Rev 10/4/2024) says what the participant actually receives: 'You will receive a letter from SBI within 2 weeks that tells you if you are eligible for a mandatory expungement, with instructions, or if you will need to file a discretionary expungement with Superior Court. i. If you qualify for mandatory expungement will need to follow directions received with criminal history, with $75.00 filing fee.' The instrument is a letter and instructions SBI mails to the individual applicant with their certified criminal history — not a published blank form.

perItem.nextOperationOwner: The question is not 'which URL' and it is not a question for a clerk. It is: does Delaware publish a mandatory-expungement application at all, or is the § 4373 mandatory path an SBI-initiated determination the participant triggers by requesting a certified criminal history? If the latter, de_mandatory_expungement-set is modelled official_pdf_fill on a document that does not exist, and the honest treatment is guidance — request the certified history through IdentoGo service code 27S23V, wait for the SBI eligibility letter, follow the instructions it carries — exactly as the Washington juvenile family resolved. A single human read of https://dsp.delaware.gov/expungements/ settles it; this container cannot make that read.

perItem.finding: The label does not name one document and it never did. The composed-route dependency files say so in their own words: 'Master Library Edition 1.1 gives the OCA MMRTA Proposed Order and the OCA MMRTA Certificate of Service the same document ID, MT-OCA-MMRTA, distinguished only by document role, ORDER against SERVICE. They are two different binaries with two different SHA-256 values, so a component naming MT-OCA-MMRTA matches two retained assets carrying conflicting hashes and the authority gate records an authority hash conflict.' This is NOT a pick-one ambiguity: both instruments are requirement 'required' on this route and the route files both. The certificate of service is required by § 16-12-113(5)(b) and is marked required on the face of both Form A and Form B; the proposed order is submitted with the petition. Two exact binary addresses are established for the first time and carried in manifestEntriesAdded.
perItem.nextOperationOwner: Acquisition, for the two new addresses. Then the census owner, to split MT-OCA-MMRTA into two per-instrument identities — the registry already records that split as the mechanical cure and this lane does not own the census vocabulary. Until the split, the family keeps sourceState FAMILY_IDENTITY_AMBIGUOUS mechanically (model check S11) even though nothing about the documents is ambiguous any more.

A downstream reader sees MT-OCA-MMRTA as addressed and acquired, and it is not: what was acquired is the Supreme Court order that adopted the rules.
contradictionsWithTheRepository.howThisLaneResolvedIt: Two entries added in manifestEntriesAdded, completing the set rather than superseding the adopting order. The label genuinely covers three documents and the manifest should carry three addresses.

whatThisDoesNotEstablish: That any address here is reachable. Nothing was fetched by this lane.
That any Montana or Delaware DOCX is in the committed corpus index. None is; the index does not index DOCX.
That the TX 411.0736 order at the acquired address prints §411.0736 on its face. Its bytes are not held and its face was not read. That check belongs to promotion.

That either MMRTA companion instrument is the CURRENT edition. Both held copies carry 2022 document metadata and no printed revision; whether the Office of the Court Administrator still issues those bytes is settled only by fetching.

That Delaware publishes no SBI application. This lane establishes that no held or committed record names one and that the publisher's own instructions describe a mailed letter instead. A human read of the programme page settles the question either way.
grantsNothing: A bound source is a bound source. It builds nothing, proves nothing and approves nothing.
